summary: Iteration 105 — Phase 2 (student absence excuses) tested across backend + admin web UI. Backend reference flow /app/backend/tests/test_student_excuses_flow.py passed 100% (ALL PASSED) covering: meta, missing-attachment 400, routing (medical→registration regardless of days, family 2d→dean, official 3d→board, exam 1d→board), overlap 400, admin-on-behalf via student_db_id, /my for student, 403 for student on list, admin list with can_decide & pending_by_route, decide RBAC (Salim/dean rejected on registration route), needs_info without note→400, needs_info→student attachment→back-to-pending, approve applies excused to past completed lectures (updated=1, created=1 for lecture without record), auto-excused on attendance/session for scheduled lecture inside period, late→present for teacher-forbidden statuses, board without session_no→400, student cancel of pending, attachment download via JWT in query, student search for dept head. Also validated POST /api/admin/lectures/repair-group-duplicates?include_past=true&dry_run=true → 200 {restored:0,kept_real_duplicates:0,items:[]}. Admin web UI /student-excuses: se-page, se-route-{registration,dean,board}, se-filter-{pending,needs_info,approved,rejected,all}, se-new-btn opens se-form; se-form-search '1001' shows se-form-result-1001, se-form-from/to/type default sick→route preview = 'التسجيل · 3 يوم', file upload via se-form-files, se-form-submit creates request (alert accepted) appears in list as se-row-*; se-open-* opens se-detail with se-detail-route='التسجيل'; se-decision-approved + se-decide-submit → request disappears from pending. Sidebar text 'أعذار غياب الطلاب 📄' present. /repair-group-lectures loads repair-group-lectures-screen; repair-preview-btn shows repair-preview block. Student web UI not tested (403 by design per request).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/student_excuses.route_for correctly implements: medical→registration (any duration); exam→board; else days<=2→dean, days>2→board. Verified by UI preview + backend tests.

apply_excuse updates existing absent attendance records and inserts new excused records for completed lectures within the period that have no prior record — matches spec; auto-excuse during /attendance/session is enforced via _excused_students_for_lecture.
Teacher-forbidden statuses: late→present and excused→absent are enforced server-side (prevents client bypass).
Board decisions require board_session_no and board_session_date — enforced with 400.
Attachment download via ?token=JWT works for both Emergent Object Storage and Mongo fallback.
Overlap detection with pending/approved excuses on same student+course scope returns 400 as expected.
